paragraphs: Rabbah bar She'ilta. Gittin 39b has Rava. It appears he is the aforementioned bar Sheila. Rav Nahman bar Yitzhak spoke to him. Rav Nahman then spoke to R’ Hiyya bar Avin (Gittin 39b).
